# Pull Request

## Description
Explain what this PR changes and why.

## Type of Change
- [ ] feat (new feature)
- [ ] fix (bug fix)
- [ ] docs (documentation)
- [ ] refactor (no functional changes)
- [ ] chore (maintenance)
- [ ] ci (workflow changes)

## Checklist
- [ ] My commits follow the Conventional Commits specification
- [ ] If this PR is ready to merge, commits are squashed
- [ ] I added screenshots if the UI was modified
- [ ] I tested the changes locally
- [ ] I updated documentation where needed

## Related Issues
Link any related issues here. If this PR resolves an issue, use a closing
keyword and the issue number (e.g. `Closes #86`) so it carries into the
squashed commit message — the release workflow relies on it to auto-close
issues.
